title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning Under a Generative Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.02826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning is a subfield of machine learning that studies how an agent interacts with an environment in order to extract as large a reward as possible. A standard approach to study such interaction is through Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and the task of choosing an optimal policy---a function that tells the agent which action to take. In this work, we study two types of time-dependent MDP---finite-horizon and infinite-horizon discounted---and propose new quantum algorithms for computing approximate optimal policies. Our quantum algorithms are based on a new combination of standard value iteration and quantum subroutines like quantum mean estimation and quantum maximum finding, overall enhanced with techniques from sample-optimal classical algorithms. Our resulting query complexities improve upon previous works, thus approaching already established quantum lower bounds.

translated_title: 生成模型下强化学习的改进量子算法
translated_abstract: 强化学习是机器学习的一个子领域，研究智能体如何与环境进行交互，从而获取尽可能大的奖励。研究这种交互的标准方法是通过马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）以及选择最优策略的任务——策略是一个告诉智能体应采取何种动作的函数。在这项工作中，我们研究了两种时间相关的MDP——有限时域MDP和无限时域折扣MDP，并提出了用于计算近似最优策略的新量子算法。我们的量子算法基于标准值迭代与量子子程序（如量子均值估计和量子最大值查找）的一种新组合，并整体上融合了样本最优经典算法的技术加以增强。我们得到的查询复杂度优于以往工作，从而接近已经建立的量子下界。
tldr: 本文将标准值迭代与量子均值估计、量子最大值查找等量子子程序相结合，提出了求解有限时域和无限时域折扣MDP近似最优策略的新量子算法，其查询复杂度优于以往工作并接近已有的量子下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes new quantum algorithms combining value iteration with quantum subroutines such as quantum mean estimation and quantum maximum finding to compute approximate optimal policies for finite-horizon and infinite-horizon discounted MDPs, achieving query complexities that improve upon prior works and approach established quantum lower bounds.
